methods.name: flame.opencode/agents.v1
methods.description: List the approved ACP agent profiles on the Runtime machine.

methods.name: flame.opencode/cancel.v1
methods.description: Request cancellation of the original prompt and await its stop reason.

methods.name: flame.opencode/create.v1
methods.description: Create one native ACP session and retain its original acknowledgement.

methods.name: flame.opencode/fork.v1
methods.description: Fork the native session when OpenCode advertises the capability.

methods.name: flame.opencode/get.v1
methods.description: Read the captured session, progress, permissions and turn settlement.

methods.name: flame.opencode/list.v1
methods.description: List native sessions in the canonical workspace.

methods.name: flame.opencode/open.v1
methods.description: Restore the original native session through an advertised ACP operation.

methods.name: flame.opencode/permission.v1
methods.description: Select an option from the original pending permission.

methods.name: flame.opencode/prompt.v1
methods.description: Accept one prompt for the bound native session.
